notes.title: Welcome to Beach Ball Valley!
notes.content:
Beach Ball Valley 1.0 is out, after only 36 build updates since April 2016! 

It's been an adventure & we're happy to launch our super unique VR game into the world.  Here's a list of the changes we've added since EA launch! Thanks to everyone for joining us in early access! We've had a blast playing & making it & tweaking from your feedback! We're now at a happy, stable, carefully polished release that's so small, it would fit on a CD! 

 We've tweaked and changed a lot!

[list]
[*] photo based & hand painted graphics
[*] rebuilt and simplified the valley 
[*] removed teleporting to make it super simple
[*] added tutorial graphics to show you exactly what's going to happen
[*] made all the beach balls come to you
[*] updated unreal engine versions to include better low latency 
[*] balanced mind control around hand instead of head
[*] mind control two balls at once
[*] added a number of beach ball drops to make sure you had enough
[*] super rad beach ball model
[*] ring the bell minigame
[*] goalie minigame 
[*] demo keys show up on the pc monitor for easy reference
[*] rain cloud to grow bigger beach balls 
[*] hints that show up when you look at your hand
[*] wind in the valley will blow beach balls around
[*] magnus effect curves spinning beach balls flight paths
[*] discord rich presence
[*] keys to start minigames from the keyboard
[*] beach balls have fall and Christmas colors!
[*] pimax & virtually all other headset support
[*] keys to have beach balls jump at the player
[*] 5+ tracker support for foot & more paddles
[*] hidden advanced mode with desktop music controls & old mind control
[*] realistic binaural (hrtf) audio effects
[*] tiny coins you can eat
[*] trading cards
[*] achievements!
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Beach Ball Valley out of Early Access
notes.content:
Prepare your pizza paddles, because Beach Ball Valley is releasing on October 10th, 2020!

It's been a blast working on it and sharing it with everybody. Seeing many smiles & beach balls slammed skyward around the world.  We've tweaked and polished many areas of the game, most notably graphics, sound and haptics!

But wait, there's more!

- achievements
- trading cards
- profile badges
- beach balls
- 5 tracker support (possibly up to 11, but we couldn't test that)
- device support for pimax 8KX / index / wmr / rift / cosmos / quest (via oculus link). 

You can see the achievements right now, but you cannot unlock these achievements yet, they'll go live when the game releases!

notes.title: Update Ice Cream!
notes.content:
After over one year of testing and tinkering, we totally rebuilt the valley to put you right in the middle of the action, with as little confusion to new players as possible! This is the release candidate. Next release is out of early access!


[list]
[*] Balls come to you no matter what!
[*] Minigames are a bit different
[*] Pimax Support
[*] More hotkeys to amuse your friends
[*] New simplified mind control system
[*] Discord integration – so your friends can see how many beach balls you've hit!
[/list]

Want to know everything? [url=http://bricklightstudios.com/motioncontrol/beachballvalley/files/BeachBallValley_Manual.pdf]Read the manual![/url]

Notes:
[list]
[*] Can be played with index controllers, but they're not modeled nicely into the paddles
[*] Tracker Support might not work due to issues in STEAMVR itself – should resolve presently
[/list]

The original valley will always be available – check it out under the original-valley branch in beta tab when you select game properties. 
Here's a [url= https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=380122528]handy guide.[/url]

notes.title: Update Huckleberry
notes.content:
[h1]Hand Mind Control![/h1]
[list]
[*] You can wave your hand like a trademarked movie character and if you're holding the grip, and if you've touched a beach ball, you can influence it with beach ball mind tricks!
[*] Either hand works, so you can do two at once, or can you?
[/list]

[h1]Spectator Screen[/h1]
[list]
[*] There are a variety of keys you can use to interact with your friends, now we show them on the main screen. Space to toggle on/off. No perf hit either way.
[/list]

[h1]Bonuses[/h1]
[list]
[*] Big Beach balls show up now and then. Nobody really know where they come from or why they're here, but they're nice to play with. 
[*] Rain Cloud is more happy and loves to water the beach balls.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Minigames now end when you leave the area
[*] It's easier to make a shot that bounces off the castle roof and hits the hoops
[*] Paddleball is now always 8 proper hits away
[*] Balls pop less easily
[*] Music minigame launchers are better timed
[*] Tracking puck functionality isn't crashing the world anymore. *(probably)*
[*] Grass is now greener on the other side
[*] Holographic hint paddle system shows players how to start the first game or teleport so you probably don't have to tell them anything for them to move around in the game!
[*] Music minigame metronome goes away farther so it's harder to hit by accident
[/list]

[h1]Super Rare Secret Advanced Mode[/h1]
[*] Click the backs of the controllers into each other, you'll see some magical puff, and then mind control reverts to the original and challenging system of actually moving your head around because you're rad Mind control

notes.title: Update Grand
notes.content:
Beach Ball Valley Update Grand!

We've updated weather systems to reflect standard cloud diversity. There are now happy clouds and angry clouds. You'll know which are which!


Also, there are now buttons to press to start games for all the games.


To top things off, we've added a new beach ball! It's Grand!


Oh, and one more thing. Try hitting a beach ball 10 times with the same paddle.

notes.title: Update Finnish Pancake
notes.content:
[h1]Exciting new features[/h1]
Squishy Buttons. Media Menus. Music Game. More Fluffy Clouds! Octopus Ready!

[h1]Music game! [/h1]
Any song ever, on time, every time. Just tap the tempo! 

Pick scored or freeplay. Tap in a tempo, preferably to the music you're listening to; desktop music, the radio or even a live band! Hit beach balls with the beat! Retap the tempo when it changes, or tap the escape button to escape.

[h1]Puck Tracker Support[/h1]
Vive Puck Trackers now work as extra paddles; stick 'em everywhere! Play with your friends or your cat, or you feet. Add 'em on your arms to basically become an octopus. You can use a lot of trackers, way more than 3. Just turn 'em on and go! If you have enough arms, because you're an octopus, you could play with 8 paddles at once.

[h1]Squishy buttons.[/h1]
They're the best. They're highly robust and very squishy. Way better than springy buttons. They'll let you change music, start games, and teleport!



[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Lots of little visual improvements.
[*]You can't glitch the ball through the floor anymore, don't even try it!
[*]Ctrl+M disables triggering the music menu in case your guests won't stop triggering it. 
[*]K = explode all the beach balls away from you
[*]End = end game, fade to white.
[*]Home = restart game, fade in!
[/list]

Full Details, cheat codes, inspirational quotes, bug reports and gameplay guide in the [url=bricklightstudios.com/motioncontrol/beachballvalley/files/BeachBallValley_Manual.pdf]manual.[/url]

notes.title: Beach Ball Valley Update EMU
notes.content:
If you're trying to figure out the code, you may have noticed we've been releasing each update based on alphabetic animal names! This is pretty much accurate so far.

[h1] Squishy Button Teleport System!	[/h1]
[list]
[*]Easy to squish
[*]Colorful
[*]Makes sense where you're going
[*]Open it up with the teleport button
[*]Fully haptic enabled squishery
[*]Squishy
[/list]

[h1] Squishy Button Desktop Play Control[/h1]
[list]
[*]Easy to squish
[*]Control your happy tunes from in VR
[*]Sometimes tells you what music player you have
[*]Opens with the triggers!
[/list]

[h1]Coin Drop for your friends[/h1]
[list]
[*]C on the keyboard
[*]Drops edible coins
[*]Don't drop too many coins, they don't grow on trees!
[/list]

[h1]Even more things![/h1]
[list]
[*]Nicer haptics
[*]Nicer graphics
[*]Softer clouds
[*]Tooltips on controller - look close!
[*]Activate a tooltip that points to a button with 1-8 (manual for details)
[*]Beach Ball Waterfall works from down the canyon
[*]Neater particles! Poof!
[*]Zero gravity is working!
[*]Beach Balls are way friendlier
[*]Secret Giant Mode activation added!
[*]Tips of Castle Turrets ding when hit!
[/list]

Also, we created the back end code for a really big cool update that we're excited about, but we decided to release this right now instead of waiting anymore! Cheers!

notes.title: Beach Ball Valley Update Dragonfly
notes.content:
We've added another minigame!
Try to keep the balls out of the goal. Or in! Go for AN EXACT NUMBER! DECIDE YOUR OWN DESTINY! 
Or just enjoy huge flocks of beach balls rolling down the hill. We won't tell you what to do. (Well, we kinda did, but ignore that, aight?)

Beach Balls don't get stuck in turrets, or stop in the minigame.

General tweaking of programmy things behind the scenes.
Small tweaks of graphical things including clouds and castle turrets and teleport arrows.

Super fancy scoreboards with extra fun. Careful though; they're not tied together well, and can break apart if you treat 'em roughly.

Mind Control: It's now semi-officially in the game.

Somebody got over 1,000,000 points in the minigame. That's pretty rad. Shoot for the stars!

Also, check out the manual! It has keys you can use to annoy your friends!

notes.title: Update Cuddlefish
notes.content:
[h1]Performance:[/h1]
We've cleaned up pretty much everything, so now you shouldn't be able to drop frames.
The storm systems and beach ball exit has been reworked. Turns out they're getting smarter faster, but they don't all leave at once.  

Of course, we've made a new way to drop frames: Super Sampling! (resolution scaling or screen percentage) It's a very costly way to increase the visual fidelity by rendering more pixels and scaling them down to fit inside your headset. 

Numpad 1-4 set to distinct levels, 3 being default.
Numpad +/- add or remove 25 to the screen percentage. (You start at 200)

More details in the manual!


[h1]Minigame:[/h1]

There are now combos. You should be able to score way more points!
Also, it makes sounds. Who cares about points when you can make sounds?
You can still make points in the minigame when the hoops are shrinking!


[h1]Teleporting:[/h1]

Hold down the teleport button (menu button with a blue arrow) and look at the arrow you'd like to follow. Then let go.

[h1]Little things:[/h1]

Keys show arrows that point to the buttons on the controllers, so a demo operator doesn't have to tell everyone what to press.
[olist]
[*]big thumpad button (launch beach ball) 
[*]small menu button (teleport) 
[*]trigger (big beach balls) 
[*]grip (!?!?!)
[*]big thumpad button (launch beach ball) 
[*]small menu button (game / ui) 
[*]grip (!?!?!) 
[*]big (beach ball) 
[/olist]
Tiny arrows point to the active beach ball launcher when you rest your fingers on the touch pads.

Small body collision so you can hold beach balls.

Slot canyon valley sculpted so the beach balls don't get stuck anymore

[h1]Big things:[/h1]
Giant mode is now working very nicely!

notes.title: Update Butterfly!
notes.content:
Beach Ball Valley Update Butterfly!

Mostly just a bunch of stuff behind the scenes to allow us to rapidly test and implement new ideas, games, locations and Beach Ball Launchers.

We've redone the hand controls so nobody accidentally teleports.
Now you can use your thumbs to launch beach balls. 

We've added a few handy things:

[h1]Score Boards![/h1]
Try to hit 'em with a beach ball

[h1]New zones:[/h1]
BEACH BALL WATERFALL
Beach Ball Canyon
Home of the future Beach Ball radio satellite telescope

Graphics Quality (super sampling)
Numpad 1-4 will give you 100% - 400%. Default is 200%, and higher end cards can run 300%. 400% isn't running on GTX 1080s. Yet, but when SMP for all 10xx card users rolls out, it'll be fantastic.

Cheers!

[h1]New Hotkeys for playing with your friends:[/h1]
Play with your friends: 
(Tell your friends to do silly stuff, and hit a key to make 'em think it's in the game)

G – Toggle Giant Mode 		
Z – Toggle Zero Gravity 		(only applies to currently active beach balls)

I – Attract Beach Balls           	(Rapid fire this for best (or worst) results)
A – Attract a single Beach Ball

B – Spawn a huge beach ball 	(Same as one of the grips, but useful for droppin' on friends)
E – Launch a Beach Ball from where the player is looking
W – Launch a Beach Ball 	 	(alternate Launcher point if available)

Break stuff:
D – Debug Pawn (ruins vr, allows you to zip around without vr enabled)
F – Add a Storm System 		(does not attack until the next time you go over the ball limit)
P – pop all the balls 			(but why?!)
ESC – Quit Game

Graphics:
Screen percentage: 
Numpad 1 = 100%
Numpad 2 = 200% (default)
Numpad 3 = 300% 
Numpad 4 = 400% (too much for a gtx 1080 =) )

notes.title: Update Alpaca!
notes.content:
Alpacas are fuzzy little animals. This is update Alpaca! It's little, but has some nice changes.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QtP_bh2lMXc]Magnus Effect[/url]
Beach balls now curve in flight based on their rate of spin.

Key Mapping Changes
[list]
    [*]Triggers = spawn beach balls (based on where you are)
    [*]Touch Pads = Teleport 
    [*]Grips = Don't teleport you anymore by accident.
    [*]Giant Mode ( g ) Now works on the first time you hit G.
    [*]Attract ( i ) - for impulse. Add attraction forces to the player's head. 
               When hit repeatedly, can cover them in beach balls.

As always, have the players do something silly to "activate" these debug commands and be sure to watch closely and press 'em every time so they don't realize it's you. 

We switched up the secret magical control mode and there's a new secret, accessible in game. Don't tell anybody!
